fact: National Instruction 3 of 2011 requires every case docket to be registered immediately on CAS and its contents scanned onto the E-Docket system, stations without access to CAS to register dockets in the Crime Register (SAPS 1), and dockets to be recorded manually on a SAPS 441 form for later capture when CAS is offline.
title: National Instruction 3 of 2011: Registration of Case Dockets on the Crime Administration System (CAS)
